hitter.label: HR
hitter.desc: Home runs.

hitter.label: SO
hitter.desc: Strikeouts.

hitter.label: AVG
hitter.desc: H / AB.

hitter.label: OBP
hitter.desc: (H + BB + IBB + HBP) / (AB + BB + IBB + HBP + SF).

hitter.label: SLG
hitter.desc: Total bases / AB.

hitter.label: OPS
hitter.desc: OBP + SLG.

hitter.label: ISO
hitter.desc: SLG - AVG.

hitter.label: BABIP
hitter.desc: (H - HR) / (AB - SO - HR + SF).

hitter.label: wOBA
hitter.desc: Savant's woba_value summed over woba_denom: linear weights of each PA result, scaled to OBP.

hitter.label: K%
hitter.desc: Strikeouts per PA.

hitter.label: BB%
hitter.desc: Walks (incl. intentional) per PA.

hitter.label: BB/K
hitter.desc: Walks per strikeout.

hitter.label: HR/PA
hitter.desc: Home runs per PA.

hitter.label: XBH/PA
hitter.desc: Extra-base hits per PA.

hitter.label: HBP%
hitter.desc: Hit by pitch per PA.

hitter.label: Swing%
hitter.desc: Swings per pitch.

hitter.label: Zone% seen
hitter.desc: Share of pitches seen in the strike zone (Savant zones 1-9).

hitter.label: Z-Swing%
hitter.desc: Swings at pitches in the zone.

hitter.label: Chase%
hitter.desc: Swings at pitches outside the zone (O-Swing%).

hitter.label: Contact%
hitter.desc: Contact (fouls and balls in play) per swing.

hitter.label: Z-Contact%
hitter.desc: Contact per swing in the zone.

hitter.label: O-Contact%
hitter.desc: Contact per swing outside the zone.

hitter.label: Whiff%
hitter.desc: Swinging strikes (incl. foul tips) per swing.

hitter.label: SwStr%
hitter.desc: Swinging strikes per pitch.

hitter.label: Called strike%
hitter.desc: Called strikes per pitch seen.

hitter.label: CSW% against
hitter.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.

hitter.label: First-pitch swing%
hitter.desc: Swings at the first pitch of a PA.

hitter.label: First-pitch strike% seen
hitter.desc: First pitches that were strikes (called, swinging, foul or in play).

hitter.label: Pitches/PA
hitter.desc: Pitches seen per plate appearance.

hitter.label: Two-strike whiff%
hitter.desc: Whiffs per swing with two strikes.

hitter.label: Heart swing%
hitter.desc: Swings at pitches in the heart of the zone (attack zones).

hitter.label: Chase-zone swing%
hitter.desc: Swings in the chase band (133-200 % of the zone).

hitter.label: Waste swing%
hitter.desc: Swings at waste pitches (beyond 200 % of the zone).

hitter.label: Decision value
hitter.desc: Runs gained by swing/take choices alone (swing model, centred on the league): for every pitch, the run value of the choice made minus the expected value of the league's swing probability there; contact quality is excluded.

hitter.label: Decision value /100
hitter.desc: Decision value per 100 pitches.

hitter.label: Zone decisions
hitter.desc: Decision value on pitches in the zone.

hitter.label: Chase decisions
hitter.desc: Decision value on pitches outside the zone.

hitter.label: Expected swing%
hitter.desc: The league swing probability for the pitches he saw (location, count, pitch shape).

hitter.label: Swing% over expected
hitter.desc: Swing% minus expected swing%: aggression beyond what the pitches called for.

hitter.label: Bad-take rate
hitter.desc: Share of his takes on which swinging had the higher expected run value (lower is better).

hitter.label: Bad-swing rate
hitter.desc: Share of his swings on which taking had the higher expected run value.

hitter.label: Exit velocity
hitter.desc: Mean exit velocity on balls in play.

hitter.label: EV90
hitter.desc: 90th percentile exit velocity.

hitter.label: Max EV
hitter.desc: Hardest-hit ball.

hitter.label: Launch angle
hitter.desc: Mean launch angle.

hitter.label: Launch angle SD
hitter.desc: Spread of launch angles (lower = more consistent).

hitter.label: Hard-hit%
hitter.desc: Balls in play at 95+ mph.

hitter.label: Barrel%
hitter.desc: Barrels (Savant launch_speed_angle 6: the speed/angle combinations worth a .500 AVG and 1.500 SLG) per ball in play.

hitter.label: Barrels/PA
hitter.desc: Barrels per plate appearance.

hitter.label: Sweet-spot%
hitter.desc: Launch angle 8-32 degrees.

hitter.label: Solid contact%
hitter.desc: launch_speed_angle 5.

hitter.label: Flare/burner%
hitter.desc: launch_speed_angle 4.

hitter.label: Under%
hitter.desc: launch_speed_angle 3: hit under.

hitter.label: Topped%
hitter.desc: launch_speed_angle 2.

hitter.label: Weak%
hitter.desc: launch_speed_angle 1.

hitter.label: HR distance
hitter.desc: Mean projected home-run distance.

hitter.label: Fly-ball distance
hitter.desc: Mean distance of fly balls.

hitter.label: Longest ball
hitter.desc: Longest projected distance.

hitter.label: xwOBA+ (ours)
hitter.desc: Our expected wOBA: each ball in play scored from exit velocity, launch angle, hang time, the park (its five fence distances, mean wall height, elevation and roof) and sprint speed; walks, HBP and strikeouts at their wOBA values.

hitter.label: xwOBA+ (park-neutral)
hitter.desc: xwOBA+ with every ball re-scored in a standard park (330/375/400 ft, 8 ft walls, median elevation, open roof).

hitter.label: xwOBA (Savant)
hitter.desc: Savant's xwOBA (estimated_woba_using_speedangle on balls in play).

hitter.label: xwOBA+ minus xwOBA (Savant)
hitter.desc: xwOBA+ minus Savant's xwOBA: what hang time, the park and sprint speed add to exit velocity and launch angle.

hitter.label: wOBA minus xwOBA+
hitter.desc: Results above expectation (positive = outperforming contact quality; regresses).

hitter.label: xBA
hitter.desc: Savant expected batting average.

hitter.label: xSLG
hitter.desc: Savant expected slugging.

hitter.label: xwOBAcon+
hitter.desc: xwOBA+ on balls in play.

hitter.label: xwOBAcon (Savant)
hitter.desc: Savant's xwOBA on balls in play.

hitter.label: GB%
hitter.desc: Ground balls per ball in play.

hitter.label: LD%
hitter.desc: Line drives.

hitter.label: FB%
hitter.desc: Fly balls.

hitter.label: PU%
hitter.desc: Pop-ups.

hitter.label: Pull%
hitter.desc: Spray angle more than 15 degrees to the pull side.

hitter.label: Straightaway%
hitter.desc: Within 15 degrees of centre.

hitter.label: Oppo%
hitter.desc: More than 15 degrees to the opposite field.

hitter.label: Pull-air%
hitter.desc: Pulled line drives and fly balls per ball in play (the most valuable batted-ball direction).

hitter.label: Oppo-air%
hitter.desc: Opposite-field line drives and fly balls.

hitter.label: HR/FB
hitter.desc: Home runs per fly ball.

hitter.label: Bat speed
hitter.desc: Mean bat speed (sweet spot, competitive swings with 50+ mph).

hitter.label: Adjusted bat speed
hitter.desc: Bat speed relative to the expectation for his pitches (count, location, pitch speed), shrunk with 50 swings, plus the league mean.

hitter.label: Fast-swing%
hitter.desc: Swings at 75+ mph.

hitter.label: Swing length
hitter.desc: Distance the bat head travels (ft).

hitter.label: Adjusted swing length
hitter.desc: Swing length relative to the expectation for his pitches.

hitter.label: Squared-up% (contact)
hitter.desc: Contact with 80 %+ of the attainable exit velocity (1.23 bat speed + 0.23 pitch speed).

hitter.label: Squared-up% (swing)
hitter.desc: Squared-up per swing.

hitter.label: Squared-up over expected
hitter.desc: Squared-up rate minus the model's expectation for the pitches he made contact with.

hitter.label: Attack angle
hitter.desc: Vertical angle of the bat's path at contact.

hitter.label: Path mismatch
hitter.desc: Mean |attack angle + pitch VAA|: how far his swing plane is from the pitch plane.

hitter.label: Path matched%
hitter.desc: Swings within 5 degrees of the pitch plane.

hitter.label: Attack direction
hitter.desc: Horizontal angle of the bat path (+ toward the pull side).

hitter.label: Swing-path tilt
hitter.desc: Tilt of the swing plane.

hitter.label: Contact point (rel.)
hitter.desc: Intercept point in front of the body relative to the league (in; + = out front).

hitter.label: xwOBA v fastballs
hitter.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with fastballs.

hitter.label: Whiff% v fastballs
hitter.desc: Whiffs per swing v fastballs.

hitter.label: Run value/100 v fastballs
hitter.desc: Batting run value (Savant delta_run_exp) per 100 fastballs seen.

hitter.label: Chase% v fastballs
hitter.desc: Swings at fastballs outside the zone.

hitter.label: xwOBA v breaking balls
hitter.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with breaking balls.

hitter.label: Whiff% v breaking balls
hitter.desc: Whiffs per swing v breaking balls.

hitter.label: Run value/100 v breaking balls
hitter.desc: Batting run value (Savant delta_run_exp) per 100 breaking balls seen.

hitter.label: Chase% v breaking balls
hitter.desc: Swings at breaking balls outside the zone.

hitter.label: xwOBA v offspeed
hitter.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with offspeed.

hitter.label: Whiff% v offspeed
hitter.desc: Whiffs per swing v offspeed.

hitter.label: Run value/100 v offspeed
hitter.desc: Batting run value (Savant delta_run_exp) per 100 offspeed seen.

hitter.label: Chase% v offspeed
hitter.desc: Swings at offspeed outside the zone.

hitter.label: xwOBA v 95+ mph
hitter.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with a pitch at 95+ mph.

hitter.label: Whiff% v 95+ mph
hitter.desc: Whiffs per swing at 95+ mph.

hitter.label: xwOBA v 90-95 mph
hitter.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with a pitch at 90-95 mph.

hitter.label: Whiff% v 90-95 mph
hitter.desc: Whiffs per swing at 90-95 mph.

hitter.label: xwOBA v under 90 mph
hitter.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with a pitch at under 90 mph.

hitter.label: Whiff% v under 90 mph
hitter.desc: Whiffs per swing at under 90 mph.

hitter.label: Run value/100 (heart)
hitter.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the heart attack zone.

hitter.label: Run value/100 (shadow)
hitter.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the shadow attack zone.

hitter.label: Run value/100 (chase)
hitter.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the chase attack zone.

hitter.label: Run value/100 (waste)
hitter.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the waste attack zone.

hitter.label: Shadow swing%
hitter.desc: Swings at pitches on the edges (shadow attack zone).

hitter.label: wOBA v LHP
hitter.desc: wOBA against left-handed pitchers.

hitter.label: wOBA v RHP
hitter.desc: wOBA against right-handed pitchers.

hitter.label: xwOBA v LHP
hitter.desc: Savant xwOBA v LHP.

hitter.label: xwOBA v RHP
hitter.desc: Savant xwOBA v RHP.

hitter.label: K% v LHP
hitter.desc: Strikeouts per PA v LHP.

hitter.label: K% v RHP
hitter.desc: Strikeouts per PA v RHP.

hitter.label: PA share v LHP
hitter.desc: Share of his PAs against left-handers.

hitter.label: Platoon gap
hitter.desc: |wOBA v same-handed pitchers - wOBA v opposite-handed| (switch hitters: |v LHP - v RHP|).

hitter.label: WPA
hitter.desc: Win probability added: the change in our win expectancy (Markov model on inning, half, outs, bases, score) over his PAs.

hitter.label: WPA/LI
hitter.desc: Context-neutral wins: sum of WPA / leverage.

hitter.label: Clutch
hitter.desc: WPA / pLI - WPA/LI (FanGraphs' definition).

hitter.label: pLI
hitter.desc: Average leverage index of his PAs (1 = average).

hitter.label: RE24
hitter.desc: Run expectancy added over his PAs (runs).

hitter.label: RE24/PA
hitter.desc: RE24 per plate appearance.

hitter.label: wOBA high leverage
hitter.desc: wOBA in PAs with LI >= 1.5.

hitter.label: Sprint speed
hitter.desc: Savant sprint speed (ft/s, top two-thirds of competitive runs).

hitter.label: Home to first
hitter.desc: Savant home-to-first time (s).

hitter.label: Baserunning runs
hitter.desc: Steals (wSB) plus extra bases taken on hits against the league for the same hit, base and outs (builder C).

hitter.label: wSB
hitter.desc: Stolen-base runs above average (FanGraphs' constants).

hitter.label: Extra-base runs
hitter.desc: Runs from taking extra bases on hits.

hitter.label: SB (est.)
hitter.desc: Stolen bases detected in the pitch data (estimated).

hitter.label: OAA
hitter.desc: Outs above average from our catch-probability model (landing spot, hang time, alignment-inferred start).

hitter.label: Fielding runs
hitter.desc: OAA converted to runs with the season's linear weights.

hitter.label: Success rate added
hitter.desc: OAA per chance.

hitter.label: OAA going back
hitter.desc: OAA on plays moving back.

hitter.label: OAA coming in
hitter.desc: OAA on plays moving in.

hitter.label: OAA toward 3B
hitter.desc: OAA moving toward the third-base line.

hitter.label: OAA toward 1B
hitter.desc: OAA moving toward the first-base line.

hitter.label: Arm strength
hitter.desc: Savant arm strength (top throws, mph).

hitter.label: Framing runs
hitter.desc: Catchers: called strikes added over the league surface (location, count, pitch, umpire, pitcher, batter effects) times the run value of a strike.

hitter.label: Strike rate added
hitter.desc: Catchers: strikes added per called pitch.

hitter.label: WAR
hitter.desc: Bullpen WAR (regressed): (batting + baserunning + fielding + framing + positional + league + replacement runs) / runs per win, with batting from regressed park-neutral xwOBA+.

hitter.label: WAR (results)
hitter.desc: Bullpen WAR with results-based batting runs (wOBA, park-adjusted) in place of the regressed xwOBA+ batting runs.

hitter.label: RAR
hitter.desc: Runs above replacement.

hitter.label: Batting runs
hitter.desc: True-talent batting runs: park-neutral xwOBA+ regressed with the stabilisation PA, against the league, per PA.

hitter.label: Batting runs (results)
hitter.desc: Results-based batting runs (wOBA, park-adjusted).

hitter.label: Positional runs
hitter.desc: Positional adjustment prorated by games at each position.

hitter.label: Replacement runs
hitter.desc: Replacement level credited per PA.

hitter.label: WAR/600
hitter.desc: WAR per 600 plate appearances.

hitter.label: Projected wOBA
hitter.desc: Next-season wOBA from the component projections (each skill regressed at its own rate, aging applied).

hitter.label: Projected ISO
hitter.desc: Projected isolated power.

hitter.label: Projected BABIP
hitter.desc: Projected BABIP.

hitter.label: Projected K%
hitter.desc: Projected strikeout rate.

hitter.label: Projected BB%
hitter.desc: Projected walk rate.

hitter.label: Projected HR/PA
hitter.desc: Projected home runs per PA.

hitter.label: Preseason projected wOBA
hitter.desc: The projection made before this season from earlier seasons only.

pitcher.label: IP
pitcher.desc: Innings pitched (outs / 3; shown as decimal innings).

pitcher.label: FIP
pitcher.desc: Fielding-independent pitching on the RA9 scale.

pitcher.label: xFIP
pitcher.desc: FIP with home runs replaced by fly balls x league HR/FB.

pitcher.label: Pitching+
pitcher.desc: Expected run value of each pitch from stuff, location, count and sequence together (count-neutral), scaled 100 = league average, 10 = one SD of pitcher-pitch-type means.

pitcher.label: Stuff+
pitcher.desc: Expected run value from the pitch's physical characteristics alone (velocity, movement, spin, extension, release, arm angle, VAA, differences from his fastball), per pitch family, scaled like Pitching+.

pitcher.label: Location+
pitcher.desc: Expected run value of the location given count, pitch family and platoon, scaled like Pitching+.

pitcher.label: xRV/100
pitcher.desc: Pitching model expected runs per 100 pitches relative to the count (negative is good for the pitcher).

pitcher.label: RV/100
pitcher.desc: Actual run value per 100 pitches (Savant delta_run_exp, batting side: lower is better).

pitcher.label: Best secondary Stuff+
pitcher.desc: Highest Stuff+ among his non-fastballs thrown 5 %+ of the time.

pitcher.label: Max velo
pitcher.desc: Fastest pitch (95th percentile of his primary fastball).

pitcher.label: Fastball arm-side run
pitcher.desc: Horizontal break toward the arm side.

pitcher.label: Fastball VAA
pitcher.desc: Vertical approach angle at the plate (flatter = closer to 0 = harder to hit up in the zone).

pitcher.label: Fastball spin efficiency
pitcher.desc: Share of spin that produces movement (transverse spin over total), from the trajectory fit.

pitcher.label: Fastball seam-shifted wake
pitcher.desc: Gap between the observed movement direction and the measured spin axis.

pitcher.label: FB-offspeed velo gap
pitcher.desc: Primary fastball minus his slowest regular pitch.

pitcher.label: Release spread
pitcher.desc: SD of the release point (in): lower = more repeatable.

pitcher.label: Release gap between types
pitcher.desc: Largest distance between two pitch types' mean release points (tipping risk).

pitcher.label: Tunnel index
pitcher.desc: Separation of consecutive pitches at the plate relative to their separation at the decision point (167 ms before the plate), against the league curve; 100 = average, 10 = one SD.

pitcher.label: Tunnel score (in)
pitcher.desc: Plate separation beyond what the decision-point gap predicts.

pitcher.label: Fastball% ahead
pitcher.desc: Fastball share when ahead in the count.

pitcher.label: Z-Swing%
pitcher.desc: Swings at his pitches in the zone.

pitcher.label: CSW%
pitcher.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.

pitcher.label: Z-Contact%
pitcher.desc: Contact per swing in the zone.

pitcher.label: Edge%
pitcher.desc: Pitches in the shadow attack zone.

pitcher.label: Heart%
pitcher.desc: Pitches in the heart of the zone.

pitcher.label: Waste%
pitcher.desc: Pitches in the waste attack zone.

pitcher.label: O-Contact% allowed
pitcher.desc: Contact per swing outside the zone.

pitcher.label: Two-strike whiff%
pitcher.desc: Whiffs per swing with two strikes.

pitcher.label: Chase-band%
pitcher.desc: Pitches in the chase attack zone (133-200 % of the zone).

pitcher.label: BF share v LHB
pitcher.desc: Share of batters faced who hit left-handed.

pitcher.label: RV/100 fastballs
pitcher.desc: Run value per 100 fastballs (batting side: lower is better).

pitcher.label: CSW% fastballs
pitcher.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per fastballs.

pitcher.label: xwOBA fastballs
pitcher.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with fastballs.

pitcher.label: RV/100 breaking balls
pitcher.desc: Run value per 100 breaking balls (batting side: lower is better).

pitcher.label: Whiff% breaking balls
pitcher.desc: Whiffs per swing on breaking balls.

pitcher.label: CSW% breaking balls
pitcher.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per breaking balls.

pitcher.label: xwOBA breaking balls
pitcher.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with breaking balls.

pitcher.label: RV/100 offspeed
pitcher.desc: Run value per 100 offspeed (batting side: lower is better).

pitcher.label: CSW% offspeed
pitcher.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per offspeed.

pitcher.label: xwOBA offspeed
pitcher.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with offspeed.

pitcher.label: GB%
pitcher.desc: Ground balls per ball in play.

pitcher.label: Pull-air% allowed
pitcher.desc: Pulled line drives and fly balls.

pitcher.label: xwOBA+ against (ours)
pitcher.desc: Our expected wOBA allowed (see hitters' xwOBA+).

pitcher.label: xwOBA+ against (park-neutral)
pitcher.desc: xwOBA+ allowed in a standard park.

pitcher.label: wOBA minus xwOBA+
pitcher.desc: Results allowed above expectation (positive = unlucky or poor defence).

pitcher.label: xRA9
pitcher.desc: Expected runs per nine from xwOBA+ against (builder C's xruns over innings).

pitcher.label: xwOBA 1st time through
pitcher.desc: xwOBA allowed the first time through the order, shrunk with 100 PA to the league's TTO1.

pitcher.label: Velo change /100 pitches
pitcher.desc: Within-game fastball velocity slope per 100 pitches, shrunk to the league (mph).

pitcher.label: Spin change /100 pitches
pitcher.desc: Within-game fastball spin slope per 100 pitches (rpm).

pitcher.label: Velo last 3 games
pitcher.desc: Last three games' fastball velocity minus his season mean.

pitcher.label: Spin last 3 games
pitcher.desc: Last three games' spin minus his season mean.

pitcher.label: Release height drift
pitcher.desc: Last three games' release height minus season mean (in).

pitcher.label: Velo trend /30 days
pitcher.desc: Season slope of game fastball velocity per 30 days.

pitcher.label: WAR (RA9)
pitcher.desc: Bullpen WAR, results-based (RA9): runs allowed against a replacement RA9 solved so pitchers share 43 % of 1,000 WAR per 2,430 games, park-adjusted, relievers scaled by (1 + gmLI) / 2.

pitcher.label: WAR (xwOBA+)
pitcher.desc: Bullpen WAR, regressed: expected runs from xwOBA+ against instead of runs allowed.

pitcher.label: gmLI
pitcher.desc: Average leverage index when entering a game (relievers).

pitcher.label: RE24 saved
pitcher.desc: Run expectancy saved over his PAs.

pitcher.label: pLI
pitcher.desc: Average leverage of the PAs he pitched.

pitcher.label: Projected HR/BF
pitcher.desc: Next-season home runs per batter faced.

pitcher.label: Preseason projected wOBA
pitcher.desc: The projection made before this season.

presets.label: Fastball VAA against fastball whiff rate
